title: The Forge
blurb: Temper gear, copy Blueprints, attune and raise weapons: the Forge does more than it looks.

steps.text: Craft a Forge. The Anchor taught you the recipe.
steps.hint: Bricks around, iron on both sides, a blast furnace in the middle.

steps.text: Temper a weapon or an armour piece at the Forge.
steps.hint: Hold the piece and use the Forge. Each level adds damage or armour.

steps.text: Make an Armory: an anvil, a Forge and an armour stand in one room.
steps.hint: Gear tempers two levels higher for every Forge tier there.

steps.text: Use the Forge with an empty hand to open the Armoury.
steps.hint: It lists every pattern you know and what each weapon needs.

steps.text: Draw a copy of a Blueprint you know.
steps.hint: Open the Armoury at the Forge and press Draw a copy. It costs essence and lapis.

steps.text: Attune a weapon: hold a catalyst in your off hand and sneak at the Forge.
steps.hint: A Copper Ingot is the easy catalyst. It gives the weapon a Force.

steps.text: Raise a Marked weapon to the next tier.
steps.hint: Hold it, open the Armoury at the Forge, and press Raise. It needs the next tier's parts.

steps.text: Upgrade the Forge to tier II.
steps.hint: Sneak and use the Forge with an empty hand. It needs D-rank.

finish.line: You know what the Forge can do.
